statement: Implement Q3 call-shard paged execution across a dedicated paged-execution and retained-read-view owner, distributed-operation authoring and service source/entry/typings contracts, Call Cell batch executor, local partition call-cell handler, Call Cell invoker, and Call Cell reduce coordinator so every admitted paged operation executes an explicit bounded init/step/finish accumulator lifecycle with canonical finite-JSON state validation, reads from a retained per-shard read view navigated by a deterministic keyset cursor, commits page transitions atomically under the attempt fence, discards and fences the entire attempt when read-view or state custody is lost, enforces per-page and per-shard row/byte/state/page budgets, and passes multi-shard WASI verification well above 4096 rows per shard.
